title: Country rules table - Nomad Pro UK Residency Tracker
method: Each row read from the GOV.UK foreign travel advice 'Entry requirements' page via the GOV.UK content API (source_updated = GOV.UK public_updated_at), corroborated by the destination government or EU Commission where a rule changed recently. Re-checked weekly by the travel-rules-watch routine and immediately when a trip is mentioned.
legal: Not tax or immigration advice — check your own position.

rules.name: Schengen area

CY.status: Participates in Schengen cooperation; internal border controls not yet lifted by the Council. No Council decision or accession date found as of 2026-09-26.

rules.source_title: GOV.UK Italy entry requirements (Schengen 90 in any 180 days)

corroborating.title: European Commission, Schengen area (29 countries; Bulgaria and Romania joined 1 Jan 2025; Cyprus integration underway)

rules.note: Any part of a day in a Schengen country counts, including entry and exit days. The 180-day window rolls back from each day.

rules.name: Cyprus
rules.switch_to_schengen: When the Council's accession decision takes effect, set SCHENGEN.members CY 'from' to that date; the engine then counts Cyprus inside Schengen from that date and stops using this row.
rules.finding: Up to 90 days without a visa; Cyprus is not part of the Schengen area, so Cyprus days and Schengen days are counted separately. Time in the north counts towards the Republic of Cyprus 90-day total.

corroborating.title: European Commission: 'internal borders controls have not yet been abolished by the Council. The integration process into the Schengen area is currently underway.'
COM(2026) 150 State of Schengen report, 18 May 2026: priority 'Complete Cyprus' accession to the Schengen area'

rules.name: Thailand

previous.note: Entries before 15 Sep 2026: stay the period stamped on arrival (60-day scheme, revoked from 15 Sep 2026).

rules.max_entries_note: GOV.UK: visa-exempt entry for tourism is 'normally limited to two entries per calendar year'.
rules.purpose: tourism only (visa exemption does not cover business travel)
rules.finding: From 15 Sep 2026, visa-exempt entry for British citizens is up to 30 days, tourism only; normally 2 visa-exempt entries per calendar year. Entrants before 15 Sep 2026 keep the period stamped on arrival.

corroborating.title: Thai Government PR Dept (citing MFA Dept of Consular Affairs): 60-day scheme revoked; revised 30-day scheme; effective 15 Sep 2026; Royal Gazette 31 Aug 2026
Thai MFA Dept of Consular Affairs list, 30-day visa exemption (ordinary passports), UK = no. 59

rules.name: Laos
rules.finding: Visa required (e-visa or visa on arrival at listed entry points); tourist visa 30 days from arrival, single entry; up to 2 extensions (60 days).

rules.name: United Arab Emirates
rules.finding: Visit visa on arrival, valid up to 90 days over a 180-day period beginning from the date of first entry (continuous or split).
rules.note: GOV.UK says the 180-day period begins at first entry; the engine uses a rolling window as an approximation.

rules.name: Malaysia
rules.finding: No visa for tourism; normally 90 days on arrival. Online arrival card required.

rules.name: Montenegro
rules.finding: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period; not Schengen (counted separately).

rules.name: Japan
rules.finding: Visa on arrival for tourism or business up to 90 days.
